# System Architecture

## Storage Subsystem

### SQLite WAL Configuration
The filesystem RAG engine uses SQLite with Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) mode enabled by default. WAL mode permits concurrent reads while a background write transaction is active without database locking.

### Incremental Vacuuming
To prevent file fragmentation and page bloat during frequent note editing, incremental vacuuming reclaims unused disk pages.

# System Architecture

## Inference & Hardware Topology

### CPU Thread Pinning
On AMD Ryzen 5 5600XT processors with 6 physical Zen 3 cores, intra-op threads are pinned to 6 and inter-op threads to 1 to prevent hyperthreading contention.

### Neural Cross-Encoder Reranking
The cross-encoder scores candidate passages using a calibrated sigmoid activation function to project raw logits into probability space.

# Meeting Notes 2026

## Q3 Product Roadmap

### Performance Objectives
Our top objective for Q3 is achieving sub-75ms search latency across a corpus of 50,000 personal notes.

### Personal Notes Integration
Support markdown vaults with full heading hierarchy breadcrumbs and automatic exclusion of Vim swap files like .swp and .un~.
